context.conversation: Why does deployment fail with port already in use? A process from the previous deployment is still running. The shared alternatives were lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9, or pm2 restart app for the PM2-managed app. What about cannot connect to database? Check credentials, whether the database is running, and network connectivity. What should I check first? Logs: pm2 logs or docker logs. No review date was agreed.
